optionsCatalog.title: Option A — incremental fix
optionsCatalog.whatItDoes: Applies a small targeted change to fix the issue.
optionsCatalog.summary: Small targeted change with low risk.

optionsCatalog.title: Option B — rework
optionsCatalog.whatItDoes: Reworks the flow for broader coverage.

optionsCatalog.title: Option C — tooling assist
optionsCatalog.whatItDoes: Adds tooling to catch the issue earlier.

brainstormHandoff.comparison: Option A is cheaper and lower risk; Option B is durable but costlier. Selected Option A.
brainstormHandoff.recommendation: Recommend Option A — incremental fix: smallest complete change with low risk.
